description: Reference-only O-RU supply-power profile: active power is active_base_w + (DL PRB utilisation / 100) * dynamic_full_load_w; deep sleep is a non-zero fixed supply power.
calibration_note: These values are a transparent reference profile for the Fig.4 mmWave O-RUs, not a measurement of a specific vendor device. Replace them with low-load, full-load, and sleep measurements for the deployed O-RU before using absolute W or Wh results.
